name: redminportal
description: RedminPortal is a backend administrating tool for Content Management and Ecommerce sites.
author: Redooor LLP

scripts.build:css: sass src/resources/assets/scss/redminportal.scss src/public/css/redminportal.css --style=expanded --source-map --embed-sources --fatal-deprecation=import --fatal-deprecation=color-functions --fatal-deprecation=global-builtin && postcss src/public/css/redminportal.css -o src/public/css/redminportal.css --map && node scripts/banner.mjs src/public/css/redminportal.css
scripts.build:js: esbuild src/resources/assets/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.js --minify --legal-comments=inline --banner:js="/*! bootstrap-tagsinput (c) 2013 Tim Schlechter, MIT. See licenses/bootstrap-tagsinput.txt */" --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.min.js && esbuild src/resources/assets/js/redmin-fileinput.js --minify --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/redmin-fileinput.min.js && esbuild src/resources/assets/js/redmin-dashboard.js --minify --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/redmin-dashboard.min.js && esbuild src/resources/assets/js/redmin-sidebar.js --minify --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/redmin-sidebar.min.js && esbuild src/resources/assets/js/redmin-lightbox.js --minify --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/redmin-lightbox.min.js && esbuild src/resources/assets/js/redmin-post.js --minify --sourcemap --outfile=src/public/js/redmin-post.min.js
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:min && npm run build:editor:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:vendor
scripts.clean: rm -f src/public/css/redminportal.css src/public/css/redminportal.css.map src/public/css/redminportal.min.css src/public/css/redmin-editor.css src/public/css/redmin-editor.css.map src/public/css/redmin-editor.min.css src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.js.map src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.min.js src/public/js/bootstrap-tagsinput.min.js.map src/public/js/redmin-fileinput.min.js src/public/js/redmin-fileinput.min.js.map src/public/js/redmin-dashboard.min.js src/public/js/redmin-dashboard.min.js.map src/public/js/redmin-sidebar.min.js src/public/js/redmin-sidebar.min.js.map src/public/js/redmin-lightbox.min.js src/public/js/redmin-lightbox.min.js.map src/public/js/redmin-post.min.js src/public/js/redmin-post.min.js.map
